**What I can do now**

```json
displayCarStatus({"option":"fuel"})
```

This will give me the exact percentage/volume of fuel remaining. Once I’ve seen those numbers, I can tell you whether it’s below 10% and, if so, advise you on the best course of action (e.g., topping up at the nearest station).

**Starting the engine**

Once you’re ready to hit the road, I can fire up the motor with:

```json
startEngine({"ignitionMode":"START"})
```

Just let me know when you’d like me to run the `displayCarStatus` command—or share the current fuel figure—and I’ll take care of the rest!
